reasons.clean_text: Paper A has some leakage: a commit hash and file paths (pp3, 6, 7, 9) plus an 'AI use statement'; Paper B has worse leakage, with file paths, line numbers, a full hash, script commands and pipeline talk such as 'frozen evaluator' and 'qualification' throughout (pp1, 5, 11-13).
reasons.abstract_intro: Paper A's abstract and introduction (pp1-2) are dense but well argued, with clear contributions and related work; Paper B's abstract (p1) centres on evaluation-pipeline failure and its prose reads as defensive and process-oriented rather than scientific.
